prompts.head_south:
Use case: precise-object-edit, COLOR ONLY.
Asset: an existing transparent RimWorld character HEAD sprite.
Image 1 is the sole EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is a flat color swatch REFERENCE ONLY. Do not render the swatch in the output.
Task: replace only the overly pale peach SKIN palette with the sampled portrait skin base #CBB0A5, sRGB (203,176,165), a muted warm peach-beige. The large flat skin areas should be very close to that exact swatch. This is intentionally darker and less pink-white than the input; do not automatically whiten or brighten it. Skin should stay flat and simplified, with only very small low-contrast variation if necessary. Approximate light limit #D5BDB6 and modest shade #BCA093; no dramatic lighting or added cheek blush.
LOCK ALL GEOMETRY AND ALL NON-SKIN ART: unchanged head silhouette, size, face shape, short chin, eyes and eyelids, grey-green iris/pupils and highlights, relaxed eyebrows, existing nose and mouth marks, ears shape/linework, ash-grey hair and single bun, plum hat, blue-grey hat ribbon/bow, all outlines, accessory positions and transparent background. No repaint of the eyes, lips, nose, hair, clothing or hat; only change skin fills and their existing minor skin shading. Do not add new detail, gradients, texture, reflections, facial lines or realism.
Keep the exact same orientation, framing and shape as image 1. No shoulders/body/arms. Output ONE head, genuine transparent background, no text, swatches, layout, checkerboard or shadow.
View: SOUTH front. Recolor the broad exposed forehead, both cheeks, chin and visible ear skin to the sampled warm beige base. Preserve every established facial feature and softly tapered jaw. Do not change eyebrows or eye proportions.
